title: SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance
summary: SHINOBI: Art of Vengeance is SEGA's 2D action game, released on Switch 2 on September 24, 2026, at $29.99. It is one of the best-performing games on the system: it outputs 4K at 60 FPS on the TV and 1080p at 60 FPS in handheld mode, which suits a fast action game where timing matters. The install is a modest 12 GB. The physical version is a Game-Key Card, so the cartridge only unlocks the download, and you need a connection the first time you play. With 12 languages, including Spanish, and a low price, it is one of the easier recommendations for Switch 2 owners who like classic action.
